story.iWant: a step-by-step wizard guiding me through setup
story.soThat: I can successfully flash my device on first attempt
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create wizard step components (WelcomeStep, PrerequisitesStep, DeviceSelectionStep, ConnectStep, ReadyStep) - Task 2: Implement wizard navigation logic (useWizardNavigation hook) - Task 3: Replace WizardModal placeholder with full implementation - Task 4: Implement WelcomeStep content - Task 5: Implement PrerequisitesStep content - Task 6: Implement DeviceSelectionStep (integrate DeviceSelector from Story 2.2) - Task 7: Implement ConnectStep (integrate useWebUSB from Story 1.5) - Task 8: Implement ReadyStep with "Don't show again" checkbox - Task 9: Add i18n translations for all wizard steps - Task 10: Add wizard styling and animations - Task 11: Testing and verification

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: When first visit is detected, wizard modal opens with 5 steps: Welcome, Prerequisites, Device Selection, Connect, Ready
Each step has Next/Back/Skip buttons with proper navigation
Final step has "Don't show again" checkbox that updates settingsStore
Wizard is fully translated in Vietnamese and English
Dismissing wizard (X button or Skip) updates settingsStore.showWizard to false
Device Selection step integrates DeviceSelector component from Story 2.2
Connect step shows connection status and triggers connection flow

constraints.constraint: MUST replace existing WizardModal placeholder (src/components/features/wizard/WizardModal.tsx) - do not create new file
MUST create 5 separate step components in src/components/features/wizard/steps/ directory
MUST create useWizardNavigation hook for navigation state management
MUST integrate existing DeviceSelector component in Device Selection step - do not recreate
MUST integrate existing useWebUSB hook in Connect step - do not recreate
MUST use settingsStore.showWizard for wizard visibility control
MUST use settingsStore.setShowWizard(false) when user dismisses wizard or checks "Don't show again"
MUST validate each step before allowing Next navigation (e.g., device selected, connection established)
MUST use shadcn/ui Dialog component for modal structure
MUST use lucide-react icons (Zap, CheckCircle, XCircle, Loader2, etc.)
MUST follow translation pattern: wizard.{step}.{key} for all text
MUST add smooth transitions between steps (fade in/out)
MUST follow Linear Violet theme colors from UX specification
DO NOT modify core logic files in src/core/, src/auth/, src/services/

tests.standards: Testing follows React Testing Library patterns. Component tests verify rendering, user interactions, and state changes. Integration tests verify multi-component workflows. Tests located in src/__tests__/ or co-located with components. Use vitest as test runner. Mock Zustand stores for isolated component testing.

ideas.idea: Test wizard opens with 5 steps when showWizard is true. Verify step titles and content render correctly.
Test Next button advances step. Test Back button goes to previous step. Test Skip button closes wizard.
Test "Don't show again" checkbox on final step. Verify setShowWizard(false) is called when checked and Finish clicked.
Test wizard content in both English and Vietnamese. Mock i18n and verify translation keys are used.
Test X button closes wizard and calls setShowWizard(false). Test Skip button closes wizard.
Test Device Selection step renders DeviceSelector component. Verify Next is disabled until device selected.
Test Connect step shows connection status. Mock useWebUSB and verify connect() is called. Test retry on error.
Integration test: Complete wizard flow from Welcome to Ready. Verify all steps, navigation, and final completion.
